sequential_dependency.intermediate: Per-ship hull/particle roles, particle count, nose coordinate, and signed direction vector.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Extract each mixed-color spacecraft, classify hull and particles, and infer its input-dependent geometric nose and signed heading.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Erase stored particles and emit their color from the derived nose along the derived heading using the episode ray-length policy.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The same colors and particle count produce different outputs for differently oriented hulls; the ray requires the derived nose and signed heading.
